comment: Starting-grid layout, 2 rows x 4 cols = 8 bikes. Player spawns at the pole (slot P, local origin); the seven entries below are AI offsets in the start frame (+Z = bike forward, +X = bike right). dx/dz are rotated by track.start.yaw before adding to track.start.position so the grid follows the gate facing. lineOffset is the lateral racing-line bias the AI controller holds through the spline.
